title: senna pistaciifolia var. glabra
intro: Senna pistaciifolia var. glabra, commonly known as glabrous senna, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family, known for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Senna pistaciifolia var. glabra include its use in treating constipation, diarrhea, and other gastrointestinal issues due to its laxative properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to stimulate bowel movements and relieve symptoms associated with irritable bowel syndrome (IBS). The bioactive constituents of Senna pistaciifolia var. glabra include anthraquinones, such as sennosides A and B, which are responsible for its purgative effects.
